title: 도마의 칼자국
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop and J-Rock fusion. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted power chords and syncopated rhythmic riffs. A high-energy drum kit features a driving snare on 2 and 4 with rapid hi-hat patterns and frequent crash cymbal accents. A bright, clean electric guitar plays melodic lead lines in the upper register. The bass guitar follows the kick drum with a thick, overdriven tone. Male vocals are delivered with a powerful, melodic belt in a tenor range, featuring layered harmonies during the chorus. The tempo is 165 BPM in the key of E Major. Synthesizer pads provide a subtle harmonic layer in the background.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, driving drum beat]
Yeah! Yeah! Yeah! Oh yeah!

[Verse 1]
[palm-muted electric guitar, bass, and drums]
알람이 내 30분에 울렸거든
눈 떴는데 어째 나 아직 밤이야
가방 들고 나왔어 수영장까지 10분
문 열었더니 소독약 냄새가 코끝을 찌르거든
탈의실에서 옷 갈아입고 나왔어
아무도 없어 첫 번째 레인 물이 파랗고 고요해

[Chorus]
[full band, high-energy distorted guitars]
발가락을 담갔거든 차가워
온몸이 안 된다고 해 근데 들어가
물이 허리까지 올라와 심장이 조여와
첫 번째 스트로크 팔이 무거워
두 번째 [vocal ad-lib] Hey! Hey!
세 번째 [vocal ad-lib] Hey! Hey!
세 바퀴 돌았어 몸이 풀렸어
